text: Nice enough hat.

title: Mighty night is just right!
text: Fit right, quality fabric and good boy’s style!

title: Great gift
text: This is a cute necklace to give as a gift to your best friend. It comes in a nice box and is overall packaged well.

title: Slippers
text: Very comfortable came very quickly, but I’m going to order another pair in the future. I plan on ordering 1/2  One Size smaller because they stretch out.

title: Don’t Be Fooled
text: Nowhere in the description does it say this is a model kit with tons of pieces that you have to put together.  Very light plastic and even if I were in the mood to glue a car kit together, it still isn’t worth the money.

title: Waste of Money and Time
text: The propellers don’t stand erect.  They fall to the side like a limp noodle.  Very disappointing since I got them for a birthday party.  Had to return them.  The wire is too long and too bendy and the propeller and beads were clearly added as an afterthought.  Don’t waste your money.

title: Broke
text: This watch does not keep time, it's really lightweight and flimsy, and broke after 4 days of barely using it.  This was a waste of money.  And the ring.  Don't get me started on the ring.  The metal coating on it was flaking off of it immediately, and it has jagged edges.  Ouch.

title: So soft
text: I love the feel of this turtleneck and it fits my daughter perfectly.  I can tell it's going to last a while, which is great.  Even after washing there is no pilling.  Never need to iron it.  I'm happy with this purchase and the price.

title: Cute and Great Quality T-Shirt
text: This T-shirt has a great saying which my adult daughter will love!  The quality is excellent!

title: Cute... but
text: My grandson loves pandas! I had to get this for him.  I washed it prior to giving it to him because it smelled like vinegar.  I washed in cold water.  I put it in the dryer on delicate and I pulled it out before it was completely dry.  Since it is angift I was hoping that it would look like new.  It was pretty wrinkled.  Anyhow... he still liked it because it's a panda.

title: Bright, colorful and comfy!
text: My grandsons love their new pjs with sharks!!!  Great fit and bright colors!

title: Thin fabric
text: Love the style, but so thin you need to wear a slip under it.

title: Can't beat Nautica!
text:
These are the most comfortable pj's I have found!
I especially like that the top is longer....which is flattering.

title: I can use them for gifts.
text: Decided I really did not want all of these, but waited too late to return them. Guess I can use them for gifts.

title: Pretty, great spring/summer sweater.
text:
I like light sweaters in the summer. This is perfect, nice drape, will work well with some of my sleeveless summer a line dresses.
Slimming, with a just a bit of a flair at the hips which I like. I’m a size 8, ordered medium, fits well.

title: Great value.
text: Product is exactly as advertised. Great value.

title: Good purchase
text: Good quality & beautiful design

title: Stylish
text: I use this when running outside in the cold & it works well to keep my ears warm. Haven’t washed it yet so I don’t know how it will hold up.

title: Please make more patterns!
text: This is actually my second shirt because I got bleach on my first one.  I really love the fit and it covers well in length if you’re overweight and don't like your belly exposed.  I wish this came in a multitude of colors and patterns because I would certainly buy more!

title: Not Comfortable
text: I thought I would love these. They fit well. However, the foot bed was way too structured and hard for me. It just didn’t hit my foot in the correct places, causing more foot pain. The arch was too far toward the toe for my foot. I have a pretty normal width foot and a pretty normal arch. I usually don’t have an issue with shoes. The arch was also too wide. It was the right height on my inner foot, though slightly too far forward, but the raised part extended laterally too far. Super uncomfortable shoe.

title: So Comfortable
text: These shoes are so comfortable! They’re great for someone who hates shoes, but has to wear them because it is cold. They have solid bottoms so they can be worn outside and not just indoor use.

title: Thin and Cozy
text: This shacket is on the thin side. It is great to wear with joggers and a t-shirt. The sizing is pretty spot on. You may want to size up if you’re taller because the arms feel a little short.

title: Great Sweater
text: The sweater is so nice. It is a nice thick net. Very plushy. It is long, coming down to about my knees. It is good quality.

title: Bad Fabric
text: The fabric on these is so thin and cheap. They’re not cute. They don’t hold you in at all. The fabric is some super thin swimsuit-like fabric. Think of a Barbie doll swimsuit. Can you imagine what that fabric would be like? That is the fabric for these leggings.

title: Comfortable
text: These shorts fit exactly as expected. I wear an XL in Under Armor and the XL in these fit exactly the same. I do wish they had a slightly higher rise, but that is just a personal preference. The pockets are oddly made. They feel backwards.

title: Perfect!
text: This hat fits my three year old perfectly! She is pretty small. It does have a size adjuster, so if it doubt, size up. It is very lightweight. The chin strap helps keep the hat in place while she’s playing or swimming. It dries pretty quickly, as well. Great little sun hat!

title: Cute Dress
text: I would say this runs a little on the snug side. If you're wanting an oversized fit, definitely size up. It isn't body-con in any way, but it is on the snug side when you order true to size. It is pretty long. On someone under 5'4" it would be more of a maxi dress than a midi dress. 5'5" and above, it'll be a midi dress. It does have pockets! It isn't super thick, but it isn't see through at all.

title: A Little Short
text: I'm 5'4" and I found this suit a bit shorter than I would like. It felt like the cups were just a tad lower than I really would ideally like them. The effect is that they make my boobs look a little saggy. Maybe if I had a smaller stomach, it'd be fine. But I do carry weight in my tummy after having eight babies. So, perhaps that is where some of the torso height went.

title: Great Sandals
text: These are excellent kid sandals. The velcro tabs make it easy for kids to put their shoes on by themselves. The soles are nice and thick. These are great for running around. They protect the toes. And they fit comfortably.

title: Cute Graphic Tee
text: This shirt is really cute. I did size up and am glad that I did because I'm not a fan of fitted t-shirts. The graphic is cute and the color is a really nice sage. It looks great.

title: Really Long
text: This skirt is really long. I'm 5'4" and I have to pull it up to my ribs for it to be floor length! I think it does run a little small. I usually wear a large in skirts and had to go with an x-large for this one. It is quite comfortable and looks nice. I like the colors and the fabric. It lays and moves nicely.

title: Run A Little Small
text: These run a little small. They're really soft and comfortable. They are a tiny bit thicker than a t-shirt. They don't have pockets, which is really my only complaint. I think these are made to be tight, so if you don't want them tight, definitely size up once or twice. (For reference, a size 8 and the large are a little snug.)

title: Vinyl
text: This shirt is super cute. It does run a little bit small. It is more of a women’s cut. I tend to prefer a unisex cut. The actual image on the shirt is vinyl. It is kind of thick and plasticky feeling. It washed fine and wears OK. But the vinyl is thicker than it really should be. And it isn’t as nice as a screen printed shirt.

title: Good Nursing Bras
text: I like these nursing bras. As a mama of a large family, I've gone through more than my fair share of nursing bras over the years. These are comfortable and supportive. They fit nicely. They do have removable pads inside the cups. I never understand those. They never stay put and end up causing so many issues that I just remove and toss them immediately. The clips work well. Not too loose or difficult to unclip. It came with extenders, but I didn't find them necessary.

title: A Bit Large
text: My toddler loves these shoes. They're great slippers for indoor or outdoor. The fur part is very soft and warm. They are a bit taller than other clogs. They do run a bit big. We could have gone with an entire size smaller.

title: Be Kevin McCalister
text: These shoes remind me so much of Kevin McCalister in Home Alone. They are soft and fluffy and my little guy loves them. They do have a hard sole, so they can be worn to the mailbox or on the porch for a morning cup of coffee. I mean, I guess they could wear them out if they wanted. But they're nice, cozy slippers.

title: Cute Dress
text: This dress is great, for the most part. The fabric is a butter leggings type fabric. That means it is super stretchy and soft, but also doesn't do the best job at hiding lumps and undergarments. The fit is great. It comes right to the knee. The neckline comes up nice and high. The pattern does look a little bit childish and cartoony in person. So, super soft. Fit is great. Fabric is okay.

title: Snug Little Thing
text: This outfit is very narrow. It does stretch, but baby looks like a can of biscuits ready to burst out. (She is blessed with many rolls.) It looks okay. But there are little things that highlight the poor quality of the outfit. There are loose string all over. I feel like I snip all the loose strings only to have a dozen more after the next wash.

title: Runs a Little Small
text: This sweatshirt runs a little small through the width. It is a slicker, polyester material. It is very comfortable. The inside is like a thin sweatshirt feel. Size up if you want it to fit comfortably. The colors are nice and the toddler doesn’t look weird.

title: Really Narrow
text: These little pants are cute! But the fabric has zero stretch. They’re cut on the narrow side, so my chunky girl with her big cloth diaper is certainly not fitting into these! If your baby is long and skinny and you use paper diapers, these pants might work. But for us, they are adorable, but they aren’t wearable at all.

title: Swimsuit Material
text: I very much dislike these pants. The material is that of swimsuits. That is not a pleasant feeling on normal days. I don’t like how they feel at all. The cut would be fine with a different material. Pants should not be this material. Even leggings would be odd in this material.

title: One Size Has Limits
text:
One size fits all is always a lie— pretty sure we’re all aware of this. The upper limit on these pants appears to be a size 12. I can technically fit into them, but they are more snug on my butt than I would really prefer. They fit my daughter (who is my same height and a size 6/8) perfectly— exactly like the model. So one size really fits 2-12, with the upper and lower extremes being a less ideal fit.
The material is super soft, but it is also very thin. You can see completely through the pants when they’re held up to light. So, your pants might go invisible in direct sunlight. Inside, if you’re wearing appropriate colored under garments, they’re fine.

title: Oh, This Old Thing?
text: I love the shell. I love when people say, “Hey where’d you get that?” and I say, “Oh, this whole thing?!” It is amusing. They shall itself is a light weight, but very warm. It is like wearing a blanket in public, only it is completely acceptable. Like a Snuggie that you can wear out of your house without people staring at you like you’re in Walmart.

title: Loose Fit
text: This shirt has an oversized fit. You don’t need to size up at all to get it to fit like the model. The stripes on the sleeves are a waffle knit. It is super cozy and comfortable.

title: Hard to Keep On
text: These socks are okay quality-wise. I just find them very difficult to keep on my foot. They're always wanted to slide off my heel.

title: Comfortable
text: This gown is super comfortable! It was great for the hospital after having a baby. It is also great for pajamas at home that you can easily nurse baby in.

title: Not the Same, But They Work
text: These aren't the same material as the non-maternity Felina leggings. They aren't the butter material or the cotton material. They are thicker than both. The texture is similar to the cotton ones, but they are much stretchier. The belly panel is made of much thinner/stretchier material. I purchased a size larger than my normal Felina legging size because I was worried they'd be too uncomfortable snug on my belly. I'm entering the last weeks of pregnancy and everything feels terrible. Because of the thinness and super stretch in the belly, I didn't really need to size up. The larger size do fit, but they work their way down through the day. They are a bit long on me. I'm 5'4" and they puddle a bit at the ankles. But they are comfortable and will likely be my primary pants for the next month.

title: Not Great
text: The fit and fabric of this jumper were just a miss. It shows every little bump and issue. The fit was uncomfortable. It just didn’t work well at all.

title: Love
text: This kimono thing looks really awesome. I really enjoyed the look of it. Super light, so it is great for warmer weather. It does come a little past my calves, but not quite to my ankles.

title: Okay
text: The fabric is a little cheap feeling. The fit is a little odd for my body shape, as well. It is wearable, but not something I ever reach for because the fabric feels so cheap.

title: Kimono
text: This kimono fits well. It has a tie at the front that I thought I wouldn’t like, but it is actually nice. It doesn’t make the kimono tight at all, but it does keep it from falling off. The sleeves are really large on this. The kimono itself is a little on the short side. I am 5’4” and it came right to my hips. I love the colors.

title: Fuzzy Ears
text: These are really fun ear muffs. They are fuzzy and purple. My tween thinks they are awesome. They more sit on top of the ears than cover them, but it isn’t uncomfortable.

title: Fun Sleeping Mask
text: Cute sleeping mask is so soft on the inside. It isn’t too strong of elastic. Perfect.

title: Cozy and Warm
text: Very comfortable. The colors are awesome. I dislike the very visible seams. They are even more evident than they’d be with a hand made item.

title: Dressy Pants
text: These pants fit really well and they look nice. My real problem with them is just the material. It reminds me of dress pants from the '90s. They have a little bit of shine, and they are loud. Like polyester. They just weren't quite the right look for me. The fit is great. I'm just not digging the fabric- which is purely personal preference.

title: Super Nice Coat
text: This coat is super nice. It is very warm. It has just the right heaviness to it. I don't like a super light jacket, but I also don't want one too weighty. The fur is very soft. It came in a very nice bag, which is helpful for storing it out of season. I'm really happy with this coat. It is luxurious, but wearable on a daily basis.

title: Cute but Wonky Neck
text: This is a really cute shirt for kids. It is like a thick t-shirt. It isn't quite a sweatshirt. Really, the only complaint I have is that the neck ribbing gets a little wonky after a few washes. It looses it's shape a little bit. So, it looks a little more messy on a daily basis than it really should. My son loves the shirt and it usually barely hits his drawer before he is back in it.

title: Wind Suit Pants
text: These are really comfortable pants. I think they are a little on the small side. They aren’t very stretchy. The cut is a bit weird. They look like a cross between leggings and Wind pants. The material is like an old school wind suit.

title: Perfect
text: This is the absolute perfect tunic! I love it. The fabric is so soft. It is just amazingly perfect!

title: Nice and Comfy
text:
I love this cardigan! It is nice and long. It is a super soft jersey with lots of stretch and bounce. The front was kind of weird for me at first. It isn't intended to close, so the front chest part is pretty narrow compared to other cardigans I own. But it lays so beautifully. I can also push the sleeves up a bit and they stay up. The tie dye is really awesome. It is still mostly white and I do not usually wear white (6 kids, white doesn't ever stay white on me for long) but has enough black and grey that it doesn't feel like white. I am 5'4". The large completely covers my bum in the back and the front comes down to my knee.

** Loved it so much, I got another one in solid black!**

title: Five Stars
text: Pretty cool!

title: Good quality
text: Earrings were exactly what I wanted.

title: Not for the faint of heart
text: Excellent product

title: runs big
text: runs big... but good quality

title: Great Buy
text: Love them, Comfy and great price!

title: Microfiber feel
text: I researched these wraps for a long time trying to make sure I found a soft cotton one that was comfy. Unfortunately, I chose this one. It's so big and the Velcro 8s not long enough so I can't wear. The straps are too short to wear comfortably as well. Also, I do not like the feel of microfiber because it feels weird on my skin. It is not a great product in my opinion.

title: Nice for young girl
text: I got one of these as a Amazon Vine reviewer product and unfortunately they seem to have randomized the boxes so I got a Rebecca rather than a Caroline.  I'm guessing that you would receive the right name if you ordered it from Amazon directly.  So I will review it for what the product is.  It is an inexpensive script metal name.  It has a plating of gold and looks OK, although I think it would be appreciated most by girls younger than 12.  I think it looks fairly elegant, but perhaps a bit of a cheesy idea in general.  The chain is ok and it looks ok when worn. I've switched between 3 and 4 stars and it is probably 3.5 in that we mildly like it.

title: Will make a great hiking sock
text: These are a wonderfully soft, thin and breathable pair of socks.  I tried them on for working the melting snow on the driveway then going to a movie and it felt great in both places, did not feel cold outside, or make me sweat inside.  I like the idea of odor fighting although I was wearing them in new boots so there hasn't been a test of that.  I actually can't wait to see how they hold up hiking next summer.  For now, they look great, feel great, and I'm glad I got them.

title: Love The Awesome 360 Boxer Shorts
text: I have gotten a number of reviewer products from Awesome 360, mostly socks and Boxer Shorts and I was originally a little worried about what seemed like an off brand.  But they have all proven to be of good quality and they have been wearing and washing well for months now.  I jumped at the chance to review more and I am happy to say that these have lived up to everything I have gotten from them so far.  They are comfortable cotton, good fly.  All in all great boxer shorts.

title: Well Timed Arrival
text:
Minnesota is notorious for its mosquitos and I got a reviewer hat in perfect time for trying to find mushrooms. In fact a week before it arrived, I got chased out of the woods by horse flies, so I was super excited to head back out armed with this hat. And it did prove to work for the most part. Aided with long sleeves and long pants I could wade through the swarms and look for mushrooms, but the screen ended up being a hinderance in being able to see mushrooms on the forest floor so I ended up pulling it up a lot. In the end, the search was still a failure, but a far more comfortable failure.

We also took it on a weekend trip to the bourndary waters and it served well enough during the twilight hours. It is lightweight, reasonably one size fits all and interestingly designed. I like that the net tucks into the zippered pouch on the top of the head and, while I would not want my high school crush to see me wearing it, it looks ok. It definitely feels rugged enough to last us for the rest of our mosquito needs. All in all, we like it, but it is still annoying enough that we can't love it. Although when you have a huge swarm of mosquitos around your head, you are pretty fond of it.

title: Not as flattering as I hoped
text: I got this thinking that it would really fit in with my partners hippy side.  Unfortunately, I think it was a little better in the photos than it was on.  It actually looked a lot better on our 11 year old who wore it like a sun dress than it did as an ankle length skirt. I liked the tie died pattern and the color schemed, but it kind of ballooned around her waist and just didn't have a real flattering shape.  The Elastic is tight, but did not seem to finished.

title: Underwhelming fit
text: These are very casual summer weight pajamas. That is good going into the summer. The material is very thin and designed to be very loose fitting. It is very comfortable, but it has a very unflattering, frumpy look. My partner will probably wear it, but only when lacking other options or very hot weather.

title: Kid likes them
text: These are very decent boxer briefs.  Kid loves that they are tagless, they have good elastic band and nice soft cotton.  He was not quite sure about a waistband that says Awesome 360 but he actually looked forward to wearing them today.  I have a number of pairs myself and I have been very happy with both their style and quality.  They wear and wash well and have everything I'm looking for in a good pair of boxer briefs.  Recommend!

title: Nice Cotton Boxer Briefs
text: These have nearly everything I look for in boxer briefs.  They are tagless, comfortable, nice fitting, and look nice.  The only thing that is missing is a fly hole which is a bit annoying, but forgiveable if everything else is good.  And everything else is good.  I have put two through the wash and they look good and given the quality feel of them, I would expect that they will last well.

title: A Cute Sports Bra, But a Little Snug
text: We got an XL and out of the bag it didn't look anything like an XL.  It did have a surprising amount of stretch, but I still think it is on the small side.  Once on, it did look good and the orange straps on the back look especially nice.  The chest is a little padded and it does provide some good support.  All in all, it's cute and useful, just a little tight for the size.

title: Elegant, Long and Light
text:
Absolutely gorgeous on my partner. The ivory lace gives a vintage, classy elegance to her outfit. It is a huge, but wonderfully light scarf that can easily be worn all fall through spring. I cannot wait until summer is over so I can be at her side while she wears this.

The fabric is loose knit and the lace does not contrast with the fabric, more just gives a hint of detail. It is very subtle and classy. It should accessorize with almost her entire wardrobe. Absolutely love the ivory color.

title: Daughter didn't like the graphic and zipper is tempramental
text:
This sweatshirt was not very well received. Our daughter likes baggy sweaters and sweatshirts and the overall fit I think is perfect, but the graphics were not appreciated. You may want to use a little spray antiperspirant if you think you might sweat. Also, keep the plastic backing so you can place them back on the cups for storage. title: Cool Set of Rings; Not All can be Adjusted
text:
I selected this ring set on a whim. This is the kind of set that is well-suited for someone who is pursuing a Goth lifestyle or for someone who enjoys a bit of flash. This is an interesting set with some really neat designs. However, not all of the rings in this set are adjustable as the listing suggests.

There are 9 rings in this set, all of which have been polished to a shine and the crevices filled with black to make them contrast very well. There’s an interesting assortment of designs – a couple of dragons, claws, snakes and tentacles, and even a sugar skull. In spite of the amount of metal, these really aren’t all that heavy and do not weigh you down even when you wear all of them on one hand. They do have enough shape to them that they can easily catch on clothes but that’s a different discussion.

Of the 9 rings in this set, the two largest – a dragon and a sugar skull – are made such that they cannot be adjusted. In the case of those two, they have an unbroken loop that prevents bending and stretching them open more, and that’s a problem if you have larger hands. My ring size is big – I wear a 13 – so these two rings just will not fit properly, even on my pinky finger.

The other rings in this set are all open loops and the metal used is soft enough that these can be gently pried open or pushed closed to fit better. They will not bend without deliberate effort.

These look great. Some attention was expended on detail and make these look a bit more expensive than they are.

Overall this is a nice set. All of these rings are made well and they look really nice. It is unfortunate that not all of them can be adjusted, though most can with gentle but deliberate effort.

title: Beautiful Watch, Fits Right, Keeps Good Time
text:
I typically do not wear watches, though when I do it has typically been the less expensive kind that you can find in a department store. My usual limit for spending on a watch has usually been about $35. Burei watches are a lot nicer than what I usually wear but they are not astronomically priced. I have seen several Burei watches and this one has emerged as my favorite so far. It fits me beautifully and it looks very elegant and sophisticated.

This watch has gone with a simplistic approach in design – not too cluttered and concentrate on doing things right. I have had this watch for a week and it has kept perfect time so far, though to be fair it takes months before you can tell if a watch is keeping or losing time. The face has the three basic hands: hours, minutes and seconds. It also has a small dial that tells the hour in 24-hour format. At first I thought this was strictly decorative, but it actually does work and the small hand on it moves through the day.

The face has a cut-out where you can see a small portion of the inner workings. For a better look, take a peek at the back of the watch, though the inner gears are not all that visible regardless.

This is a self-winding watch and through the window on the back you can see the weight that winds the watch as you move. So, while there is no battery to replace, it does mean that if you do not wear the watch for a while it will eventually stop.

The biggest issue I have with the majority of watches I have tried is that they usually do not fit me very well at all. They are either too tight even on the largest setting or I can’t get them to fit at all. This watch has a very generous metal band that fits me nearly perfectly. When closed, and without removing any of the links, the band has enough play in it to allow the watch to move a little bit but not so much that it turns from the top of my wrist. I have huge hands and large wrists so this is not going to work for a lot of people but in the package is a tool for removing links so you can adjust the band to fit properly.

Finally, this is an absolutely beautiful watch. I have received many, many compliments from people when they see it and they ask me about it.

This is a wonderful luxury watch, more upscale than what you will find in a department store and nowhere near as expensive as some of the more expensive brands like Rado or Tag. There are two important considerations when buying a more expensive watch: does it fit and does it keep time. For me, this watch does both and I am very satisfied with it. The fact that it is very attractive is a bonus.

title: So Soft and Very Well Made Scarf
text:
[[VIDEOID:d2988928d234f06a0c891dc9df76e75]] I am usually very hesitant to buy clothes for my wife because I will either get the size wrong, the color wrong, the style wrong or some combination of those three. A scarf is a safe bet, though, so I selected this scarf with the intention of giving it to her as a surprise. It is a nicer scarf than I expected.

This is a cashmere-blend scarf that is made of some of the softest material I have ever felt in an article of clothing, even softer than a fleece blanket which should say a lot. It has a texture similar to wool but without the scratchiness and without the distinct smell that comes with wool (I like that smell but it's very unique). The tassels are all about 3” long and are all along the short edge.

Unfolded and stretched out this scarf is a little over 2' wide and is about 7' long.

In addition to being so soft, it's well made too. I have found no blemishes in the material and no nits, pills or cuts. The stitching is tight and straight.

This is not an expensive scarf but is far and away better than I hoped. It is exceptionally soft and very nicely made. For once I just might make some points with my wife for picking out clothing for her.

title: Huge Canvas Backpack-Style Bag
text:
Most bags and backpacks I see available anymore are made of nylon or polyester blends and while they look nice initially and are easy to clean they have a bad tendency to wear quickly and fall apart. I remember canvas bags when I was young that lasted for years. This backpack/laptop bag is the first canvas bag I have seen in years and it is well made and is very large - most excellent for a college student going to classes or a hiker spending time in the mountains.

To get a fair idea of the size I decided to stuff this bag as full as I could. I was able to cram in two full-sized inflated basketballs and two junior-sized inflated basketballs, and I still had a little more room in the main compartment of the bag. This is a really large-capacity bag and is roomy enough to accommodate a week’s worth of clothes, some sporting equipment or a good many college textbooks and a laptop. I have not used a laptop backpack that has come close to being this roomy before now.

There are a good number of pockets inside and outside this bag. In the main compartment is a divider for securing a larger laptop but there is also a zippered pouch that’s ideal for pencils, pens, a mouse, power cords or other smaller instruments. It’s probably the most protected area of this bag and would be a good way to stash a mobile phone safely. There is a second small pouch on the inside that is divided up for pencils, pens and other small items. There are three exterior pockets as well, all of which are about the same size as the interior zippered pocket.

What is interesting about the exterior pockets is the fact that they have snaps and buckles, but the buckles are decorative and are actually held closed by magnets. So, there is never a need to fiddle with the buckles at all - just pull on them and they easily pull free from the magnets. There is a flap that closes the main compartment as well and this is also held closed by magnets disguised as buckles.

The main compartment can also be closed via a draw string inside, providing a little extra security for the items inside.

The whole bag is real canvas, not some polyester/nylon weave. I looked this bag over and found no loose threads, no uneven stitching and nothing loose or out of place.

This bag lacks only one thing - a reinforced bottom, which would be helpful if the bag is going to be used for heavier loads for a long period of time. I have no reason to believe that the stitching or canvas will fail, but it would be reassuring to have a leather base or an extra layer of canvas to reinforce. This is by no means a deal-breaker and is still the largest and most well-constructed bag I have used.

Another reviewer mentioned that there is no protection for a laptop in this bag and I have to agree to a point. The emphasis on this bag was construction and strength, not padding and protection. So, if using with a laptop be careful when setting the bag down.

This is arguably the best bag I have seen and used in many years for laptops or just as a generalized book bag. It is very large, has plenty of pockets and seems to be made well. It is not perfect but it is closer than most.

title: No Built-In Bikini Briefs, Bottom is Just a Miniskirt!
text:
I do love the leopard print 🐆 material of this 2-piece swimsuit set, and the black micromesh lining provides a very smooth internal fit. The strapless bandeau top features side ties and ruching that are attractive, and padded cups are definitely present. The asymmetrical skirt features a gathered side tie, and I prefer to wear it more low slung than shown in the product photos (i.e. below my navel). If you wear it high-waisted, you better have an incredibly flat stomach. If not, you just end up with a leopard-spotted abdomen lump that is less than appealing. I do think this set runs true to size, since I’m normally a 4-6 and the MEDIUM was a perfect fit.

BUT... the bottoms do NOT have any sort of built-in briefs with leg holes present like the description indicates. The skirt is truly just a tube-shaped miniskirt. So you’d have to layer it over another pair of actual bikini bottoms in order to wear this set as a full bathing suit! That critical construction snafu was really a shame because this set is otherwise very soft and pretty, but it CANNOT function as a full-coverage bikini set on its own.

title: Gives Canines 💫 The Midas Touch!
text: I think this linked gold dog collar is darling! It is surprisingly lightweight (which leads some people to think it’s plastic at first), but I can assure you that it clinks like metal, and it feels cold at room temperature, just like typical stainless steel appliances do. It lays flat against the neck, self-adjusts smoothly through the “O” ring, and feels quite sturdy, especially for small/medium-sized dogs that don’t aggressively pull. I have a 20-lb chiweenie, and if she wears this chain fully relaxed, it’s a little too big and hangs down around her shoulders, but for heavier dogs or breeds with thicker necks, it would be perfect. This product would also be great for giving photo shoots an extra bit of bling!

title: These Lil’ Cherry Sandals are Adorably Retro! 🍒
text: I think these little faux leather fruit sandals are beyond adorable!! The metallic finish on the cherries and stems gives the design a magical sheen, and the silver polka dots are super cute and whimsical. The Velcro straps seem well-placed and secure, the stitching is straight and even, and the soles feature numerous ridges for anti-slip traction. The footbed is only lightly padded, so it doesn’t offer much cushiony support, but for brief outings or photo shoots, these cuties are a true delight! This pair (tagged size 7) measures exactly 6” long from toe to heel, so use that as a dependable reference value. I feel like this design has a vintage 1950’s vibe, so the retro styling is on point too. Hope this information helps!

title: Radiating Bits of Bling! ✨
text: The fanned, half-moon shape of these earrings is quite eye-catching! All the little crystals sparkle in the light, and the stones seem securely and symmetrically set. They are super lightweight and comfortable to wear, and I think they offer a nice bit of subdued, Art Deco bling for the money. The post backs slip on and fit securely, but due to that feature, the actual straight pin/posts themselves have a tendency to bend a little when the earrings are being gripped for removal. That’s the only reason I deducted a star. I suspect that over time (over several consecutive wears), one of the metal posts might weaken just enough to snap off entirely. But all in all, I was impressed with the visual design and product presentation.

I was excited to try this shirt as it was not something I typically had in my closet. When I received the shirt in the mail, the color was beautiful! It really is the perfect color for end of summer, transitioning into fall.
When I put the shirt on, however, it was not very flattering. To give you an idea, I’m 5’4’’ and 150 pounds with a mommy tummy. This shirt fit well on the arms and through the chest but was a bit loose in my stomach which gave the appearance of a maternity shirt.

title: Daughter claims a bit tight, but has been put through a lot of wear and tear.
text:
My daughter is very active and runs around--a lot. She goes through shoes quickly both for expanding feet and for running them down. Whether at the playground or school or just general out-and-aboutness, she's never with a pair of shoes for more than two months.

These shoes have lasted for four and counting. She claimed these to be a bit small in the beginning, but even after four months she's still fine wearing them (but she'll complain every once in a while they're a bit small). The colors are fantastic; they really popped when they were new. They've faded a bit, but still retain their vibrancy. They seem light (I'm sure they're light on her feet, too), and cushiony.

title: Comfortable shirts perfect for fall
text: We received the gray and white/pink shirts. They are reasonably priced shirts (about $15 for two shirts). They are thin and perfect for the fall weather in Chicago. My daughter is picky about the type of fabric she wears and she loves wearing these shirts. The sizing for these shirts are a bit confusing as a medium is a size 6.

title: Cute kimono but can only be hand washed
text:
Cute kimono that is comfortable and fits well. I'm 5'4" and 150 pounds and this kimono does not feel oversized. I would imagine it would be too big for those smaller than me though. This color (yellow) is bright and vibrant - perfect for summer and spring! I've worn this over white tank tops with jeans. One main drawback is that it must be hand washed - this is a big drawback for me as I am a busy mom of two young kids.
I would agree with other reviewers that this would be a good option for a beach coverup.

title: Cute shirt
text:
This shirt is super cute and well made. I was very impressed with the quality. I love how it fits. I'm 5'2" and only 100 lbs so even a size small is often too big on me. This short looked like it would be too big when I first opened it, but after trying it on I really liked the way it fit. It is loose fitting and very comfortable. I love the sleeves and the design on front too, and it happens to be my favorite color! It's super cute to pair with either jeans or leggings.

title: Comfortable and Lightweight
text:
My husband loves his XMXYFWHCM sweatpants (solid black color) . He finds them to be very comfortable and lightweight. He wore them throughout the day while doing yardwork and walking the dog. Thanks to the mesh and wicking material, he didn't sweat up a storm and instead stayed cool and dry. I ordered his normal size and its an all around perfect fit...waist, length, width. Zippered pockets are on both sides of the pants, good for holding keys, a wallet, cell. The drawstring around the waist is easy to use and comfortable; it doesn't dig into his stomach when moving around, standing, sitting, etc. He especially likes the 'bell bottom' cuffs. He likes his sweatpants to be open at the bottom.

I have no doubt he will have me order him another pair. He very much likes his current pair and since he works at home, he lives in jeans, shorts and sweatpants. (jeans/sweatpants now that cooler weather is upon us) These sweatpants are comfortable, lightweight, easy to move around in, very durable-(no tears, loose threads) and fit great. The price is reasonable.

title: A Fun, Well Made Shirt
text:
I must admit, I had an ulterior motive when I ordered this shirt. Told my husband I ordered it for him. And that was the truth. I did order it for him. But I was SO sure he wouldn't like it because of the diamonds, he would refuse to wear it. And it would be MINE. lol. After 17 years of marriage, I thought I knew him inside out. Guess not. Turns out, he LOVES this shirt...diamonds and all. He's keeping it for himself.

And its a nice shirt. Very detailed. The colors are bright. No offense to the RIKPR company, but the photos above don't do the shirt justice. The colors are SO much brighter than the photos show. My cell camera stinks but I took a close up of the picture and i think you'll be able to notice the colors and detailing better.

The shirt is machine washable. It held up fine in the wash. I did use a delicates bag as recommended in the instructions and I do also recommend using one.

I ordered a size up assuming the shirt would shrink but I wound up hanging it up to dry so there wasn't shrinkage. If you're going to air dry the shirt, I recommend buying your regular size.

The moisture wicking is a great feature and works well.

This is a nice, well made shirt with a great design. Holds up well in the laundry. The price is more than reasonable. Hope my photos help you see just how detailed and colorful it really. is.

title: I Knew These Were the Boots For Me!
text:
From September through April, I live in jeans, sweaters/sweatshirts and ankle boots. I mainly wear brown boots with low heels. Nothing super fancy. I'm weird when it comes to buying brown boots. As soon as I see a pair I like, its a done deal. No need to look further, I know in that instant those are the boots I want. When I came across Shoeslocker's Women's Ankle Boots, I knew immediately they were going to be my new boots and immediately placed my order. They're perfect. I love them! The heels are the perfect height; the bottoms have rubber soles to help prevent slips and falls. And while the boots aren't super fancy, the 'V' openings make these boots different from any of the brown boots I currently own or owned in the past. I find the faux leather to be outstanding quality...VERY realistic! I have no issues put them on or taking them off. They feel great on my high arches and my large bunions don't rub against the material. They are quite comfortable to wear. I wore them all day today for the first time. My feet were not sore or tired and I didn't get even one blister.

The boots are well made. The stitching is precise and even, there are no loose threads, etc.

I ordered my normal shoe size and its a perfect fit.

I knew these were the boots for me as soon as I saw them and I was right! I do love them! I'm kind of bummed that for the next 4-5 months, I'll live in sandals and flipflops until autumn arrives. But once it does, I'll be wearing my new Shoeslocker boots and I cannot wait to do so!

title: Not Sure I'll Ever Wear Another Pair of Earrings Again! These Are All I Need!
text:
I cannot stress enough how much I LOVE these gorgeous ArtGully earrings! The detail in both pair is just beautiful. Absolutely beautiful! I wore the drop earrings (not sure what to call each pair, so I'll refer to them as 'drop' and 'spiral') to church on Christmas Eve and received quite a few compliments on them. I wore the spiral on Christmas Day and had numerous family members compliment them as well! They are, as promised, lightweight. In fact, one of my earring holes ripped/stretched years ago when a baby grabbed at an earring. Because of the stretched hole, I cannot wear heavy earrings. Both of these were fine to wear. You CAN bend the earrings to adjust to your comfort/appearance as to how you want them to hang. (be gentle..but they ARE made to be bent!) Both come with clear backings that are pretty much impossible for anyone to see. I have sensitive skin and there are some earrings that cause the backs of my ears to become cracked and peel...I did NOT have any issues with these earrings! Care instructions for the earrings are on the Amazon page and I HIGHLY recommend reading them! (Nothing hard/complicated, just tells you how to store/clean them) Its obvious these earrings are handmade. I love that the description on the Amazon page says, " This Earrings Are Handcrafted And May Have Slight Irregularities Which Is A Natural Outcome Of Human Involvement In The Process And Often These Imperfections Adds To The Handmade Appeal Of These Beautiful & Unique Pieces. " Just goes to show the care and work that are put into making these gorgeous earrings by the gifted artists who craft them! They're gorgeous and so very detailed. Its clear the artist who made them loved doing so. So much time and energy put into making such lovely jewelry! Both pair come in small, plastic bags inside a plastic storage container, along with a small fabric pouch to keep the earrings in. (Again, I recommend reading the care instructions for storage and cleaning info)

I love them. I was so sure the spiral pair was my favorite but then I put the drop pair on and changed my mind! lol. When I wore the spiral the next day, I was back to thinking that pair was my favorite! lol. They're both just gorgeous. I love them. They look wonderful if you're dressed up but also look just as wonderful when wearing jeans and a sweatshirt. I cannot recommend these earrings enough. Absolutely stunning! I think its going to be quite some time before I wear any other earrings in my collection!
photo#1 is the 'drop' earring, photos #2 the 'spiral', photo#3 is both pairs, plastic storage case and pouch

title: Very Nice, Bright and Colorful Ties!
text:
My husband works at home, so aside from having to attend a funeral, wedding or special work event, he only wears a tie occasionally. For months now, he's only had one tie to cover all of those events and not long ago, his one and only tie was demolished in the washing machine by the agitator. lol.

Recently, he had to appear in court to testify in a trial involving a family member. We had plenty of advance notice of the trial so when the 2 pack of the Awesome 360 Men's classic tie appeared in my Vine account, the timing was perfect!

One of the two ties pictured in the photo above (directly from Awesome 360's Amazon page) was in the box-the pink and silver striped tie. The solid blue tie in the same photo was not included in his 2 pack. Instead, he received a VERY nice blue/violet checkered tie. Both ties are VERY nice and both match a variety of shirts that he already owns. On the first day of court, he wore the blue/violet checkered tie and it looked wonderful! He wasn't happy when he learned he'd have to return for a second day and quite honestly, he was not looking forward to wearing the pink and silver tie. (He refers to it as 'pink', I think its more of a 'magenta' shade) The silver stripes on this tie shimmer a bit. At first he said he thought he looked like the "Gooe Humour ice cream man" (don't ask...I have NO clue where he got that from! lol) but he actually got some compliments on the tie and he ended up liking it! And it looked VERY nice!

Both ties are nice and go so well with a variety of colored shirts. Both wore well and were easy to tie without issue. These ties are very nice and a good value for the price. (After losing his other tie to the washing machine agitator, I hand washed both of these and they did very well!)

title: Lumpy appearance
text: This YEEPSYS Women's Zip Front Sports Bra has the convenience of the front zipper closure which is why I got it. I've had labrum repair surgery on both shoulders and a regular sports bra is sometimes a royal pain in the butt to get on and off. While this bra was easy to get on and off I found that the front zipper caused my shirt to look very lumpy once I was fully dressed. That is a no go for me. For reference, I'm a 36DD and the size L did fit okay. However, the lumpy zipper issue keeps me from using and recommending it. I have donated mine to the local women's shelter in hopes that another woman can get use out of it.

text:
First off, I'm a woman with larger hands so it's difficult to find decent gloves that both fit my hands and that are also stylish ('cause let's be honest, it's always nice for gloves to not only do their job but look good doing it). Well, I stumbled across these and decided to give 'em a go. Man am I glad I did!

They were delivered quickly which was very much appreciated given a heavy storm.. perfect timing. That storm presented me with the opportunity to put them to the test immediately.

I purchased the large and they fit my larger hands, well.. like a glove. I couldn't ask for a better fit. I usually get gloves that are either 1) too small (most gloves I try) where the stitching for the web between my fingers is at least an inch above my actual web so I find myself always pushing them down which causes the stitching to give out prematurely.. or 2) too large (whenever I wear my husband's gloves) where the stitching comes down to my web but the fingers are too long and I have at least an inch (usually closer to two inches) sticking out beyond the tips of my fingers which causes me to drop anything I might try to pickup. Needless to say, finding the perfect gloves has been a long, seemingly endless battle for me.

But these gloves! Oh yes! They fit! They are so soft inside and out and the color is a nice neutral color that goes with practically anything. The stitching meets my web, there is no excess material extending past my finger tips and they are lined with some of the softest fleece I've ever felt.

Back to the storm.. I wore these gloves while we bucked about a 1/2 cord of firewood. It was cold (14F, 3F with wind chill) and wet as the wood pile had snow from a previous storm on it and it was beginning to snow again. So these gloves kept my hands comfortably warm.. even after they became visibly soaked. Since they are not specifically described as waterproof, I wasn't sure how they'd hold up to the wet snow but they ended up drying out and, other than being a little dirty, looked like they just came out of the packaging.

Their stitching is impressive. There are no uncomfortable bumps or lumps that some gloves tend to have along the fingers or fingertips and the stitching around the thumb and in the palm area is very well done and appears it will survive what I need to ask of them.

Bottom line... I highly recommend these gloves! I do believe they will withstand our infamously harsh Wyoming Winters, so they should be good for you too!

title: These are NOT the Eddie Bauer Fleece Pants you have come to love!
text:
At this moment I am wearing a pair of these pants I purchased at a big box store in Navy color at least 2 years ago or like $12 bucks. Same pockets, same style --- exactly. Not 1 lint ball, not 1 tear. The only place where there's obvious wear is at the bottom, rear heels area. (And for that area, I always spray with some Shout before I throw them in the washer). In the years I have had these pants I have probably washed them 100 times. THEY ARE AWESOME. So awesome in fact, that they are my ever go to. I wear them outside in the yard. I wear them for quick trips to the shopping. They still look great and hold their shape! I thought, "They're getting old and you wear them so much you better purchase another pair now."
Now to this new purchase. First, it is next to impossible to find them online and in the stores. I know because I have been trying. Second, I paid twice the amount of money for this new pair (which is NOT ALL THE reason I am giving this product a 1 star. In fact, if they were of the same quality as my first pair I'd gladly - as demonstrated - paid twice as much with zero complaint and a 5 star rating). BUT THESE PANTS ARE CHEAPLY MADE!!!!
The material is so cheap and poorly made... so awful. I've washed them twice and they already have those unsightly lint balls! I don't get it. They look exactly the same but for the color (because NAVY was sold out everywhere). My level of disappointment in Eddie Bauer is beyond description. It is at a level that the brand name means poor quality to me such that I will never buy anything bearing it's name. When you have such a respected brand name, smart manufacturers guard their quality at a nervous, OCD level. Not Eddie Bauer. If you've been looking for a second pair of these pants, just be grateful you have 1 already and go to another brand.

title: I feel like Cathy from Wuthering Heights!
text:
This cape is everything I wanted. The weight is not too heavy, not too light; the drape is beautiful; the interior finishing is perfect; and the color is a gorgeous hazel that complements almost any outfit.

Some reviewers have expressed disappointment that the cape is not of a heavier fabric. Please keep in mind that full, long capes like this involve a lot of fabric – – if the fabric is much heavier than this, then the garment is overwhelmingly heavy. Also keep in mind that this kind of shape allows you to wrap it around your self sort of double if you are cold. It also allows you to wear a layer or two underneath in colder weather. For this reason, I adore this item for travel to changeable climates. And it looks amazing with tall boots!

title: Bring New Life to Your Purse or Handbag
text:
Purse straps often fall into disrepair. You could ditch everything and get a new purse or handbag, but if the purse or bag itself is still fine, why not salvage it instead? This VanEnjoy Pair Genuine Leather Purses Strap Handles Replacement is designed to do exactly that.

You get a pair of straps with this set. The straps are made with cowhide leather, and they utilize a lobster clasp. There are two so, depending on your needs, you could use both on a single purse or use one each on two different purses or bags. Two is best for purses, and it makes gripping and holding better, but you could go with one depending on the type of bag.

The lobster clasps on these straps take some effort to squeeze, but once in place, they seem to grip well and are unlikely to come loose, since it does take effort. The clasps are a brass- like color, which means they should match well with just about any purse.

If your purse straps or handbag straps are worn out, this set by VanEnjoy could be just what you need. So far everything seems okay, but only time will tell if they hold up, they way I hope they will. They are good from what I can tell, especially for this price point.

title: For a more Comfortable Workout
text:
When exercising, the proper clothing can make a difference. I tend to just grab whatever shorts I can find and I begin my routine, but I am aware that there are better options and that was enough to convince me to get the Gafeng Mens Running 2 in 1 Shorts.

Thin and loose- fitting, these shorts are designed for freedom of movement. They are much more comfortable to wear than regular shorts and they are useful for those who run, jog, do yoga, or for most any other type of workout. The material is slick and it helps repel moisture. It feels smooth and cool against the skin, which is what you want/need when you exercise.

With fitting, the shorts I got are on the looser side. The drawstring holds them in place well enough, but looking at the sizing chart, my waist size is in- between a medium and large. I recommend getting them a little looser because tightness is less comfortable, but it’s a matter of personal preference. Oh, and the phone pocket is a nice addition. Even when I take a long walk/jog or hike, I need to have my phone handy and these shorts provide a convenient place for the electronics.

These shorts come in a few different colors. I got black, which I prefer because it matches with most anything. Not that I am trying to make a fashion statement with my exercising shorts, but you know what I mean. Neutral is best when you exercise. I try to avoid dark colored shirts because they get too hot in the summer, and I live where it is summer most of the year. But with shorts, dark is okay.

Proper clothing can make a make a major difference when you exercise. These Gafeng shorts are made for those who run or do other forms of exercise and they definitely help make working out more comfortable.

title: It Suffices but Could be Better
text:
Swimming is a popular pastime in my household. It is warm for most of the year where I live and we have an in ground pool in our backyard. We constantly need accessories and swimwear and one that my wife found reasonably to her liking is this swimwear, Misassy Women’s Ruffled One Piece Swimsuit.

This swimsuit is true to fit. Based on the size indicated and other factors, it fit as it should. The navy blue color is nice also and the material is comfortable, or at least as comfortable as a swimsuit can be.

One area of confusion with this swimsuit is the shoulder straps- should they be worn on the shoulder or off the shoulder? My wife tried it each way but had more success wearing it off the shoulder. The pics and videos show it on the shoulders, but it doesn’t work well that way, at least for us.

The padding on this swimsuit is good overall, but another issue we had is with the open section, in the center. This area wasn’t made very well, as it has loose strings. You may be tempted at first to pull the strings, but this is not a good idea, since it could tear the swimsuit.

Overall, the Misassy Women’s Ruffled One Piece Swimsuit is an acceptable swimsuit. It does have its issues, but it’s good enough to add to my wife’s swimwear rotation.

title: Genuine Leather and it Looks Sharp
text:
I have a good number of backpacks in my household and I have different uses for each. Some of them I use for vacation travel. Others are good for taking hikes through the woods. But one style of backpack I was lacking is one made for business use and this need convinced me to get the Leather Architect Men’s 100 Percent Leather Backpack.

This backpack is, indeed, made from genuine leather and it smells like leather, the way this material should. It does look cool and gets attention because, well, you just don’t see many leather backpacks. The fact that it is leather makes it good for those times when you want to present a professional look and would rather not carry a briefcase or laptop bag.

With the design, I find it sufficient but it could be better. Take the pockets as an example. There are two small, pouch style pockets and a zipper pocket on the inside. The zipper pocket is good for holding, say, your wallet and it does zip shut to keep belongings secure. The two open pouch style pockets on the inside have limited use, however. I don’t have many things small enough to fit inside these and they do not seal shut.

Another small issue on the inside is the lack of greater division. One simple improvement would be to have a divider of some sort to split the pack into more compartments. And while I don’t use this backpack for my laptop, it would be good if there were additional straps to hold a backpack in place.

This backpack is referred to as a men’s backpack and I’m not entirely sure why because, at least to me, it seems rather feminine in design and appearance. Anyone can use it, really, and so far, my wife has used it more than me. The outside straps make it comfortable to wear on your shoulders and the handle on top works when you want to carry it as a bag. As I said, it does look and smell nice and it’s certainly good enough to recommend. Better interior design would increase my rating to five stars but as it stands, it is still worthy of four stars and a recommendation.

title: Promotes safety - generous sizing too
text:
I received this set as a free review sample. The human vest is in two pieces and once properly sized and configured should work for most folks unless you are extremely large (approaching 250+pounds). It took me about twenty minutes to figure it out and get it properly adjusted.

The canine vest is more like a lightweight cover that attaches under-belly via Velcro. The large will definitely accommodate a grown Lab.

Construction is very good. I had some concerns about the mesh or net portions of the vest, but it will hold up to machine washings, and if you are caught in the rain it quickly dries. The velcro on both is high quality and definitely catches and sticks. Most importantly, the reflective strips do an excellent job and can easily be seen in low beam headlights at least 20 meters (and probably more) away.

This is well thought out and well made. I don't know what the statistics are for folks getting hit while walking their dogs, but I cannot help but think that this set promotes safety.

title: Well designed, but one minor issue
text:
I received this as a free review sample. Since there are a lot of reviews that describe this in minute detail I'll spare you another recitation. I am going to focus on a few things that slipped past other reviewers.

First, the reason for the four stars is the top zipper for the mouth of the bag is not as well made as the rest of the bag. To me it's the weak link in an otherwise superior product. There was a metal stop on mine that actually slipped off, but I was easily able to reinsert it, crimp it with a pair of pliers and all was well. Since this bag appears to be designed to remain open like a book bag I view this is a minor problem, but am compelled to point it out.

One other minor issue is the 'handles' should be a little longer of you plan to carry this by hand in lieu of using the shoulder strap.

On the plus side, the rest of the construction is first rate. I had a seamstress friend look it over and she said that the stitching was both straight and evenly spaced, both signs of high quality manufacturing. Others have amply described the material, color and liner, so I will just sat that I agree that those are nicely done as well.

To me this is best suited as a book bag. I was able to fit my gigantic [[ASIN:B00HWMPRKC Samsung Galaxy Tab Pro 12.2]] tablet in the main part of the bag with room left over for a slim 3-ring binder and some sheet music. There are other inner pockets on both sides of the liner that help keep things organized if used as a handbag or purse.

The outer pocket ironically has a nicely made zipper. It was slightly frustrating that it was an eighth of an inch too short to accommodate my 6 inch Galaxy Note 3 phone. If the design is changed to allow that pocket to store the larger phones like mine, the iPhone 6+ and Samsung Mega this would be a perfect bag for folks on the go who want a convenient bag for their electronics. In fact, this would be the perfect large format tablet and phone bag with a slight modification.

title: Exceptionally well organized and Vegan-Friendly
text:
I own a number of Booq products, so when I was offered a review sample of this new model I accepted. Like all Booq bags the emphasis is on efficient management of space as well as protecting electronics. This bag is no exception.

First, unlike the other bags that I own this one is kind of complicated, In fact, the shoulder strap and stabilizer strap design drove me crazy at first. Even the instruction card was of little help. Basically I had problems grasping how the magnetic buckle and stabilizing straps were designed for, as well as the fact that the shoulder pad on the strap hid the magnetic buckle when I first unboxed it. I finally figured it out with patience and carefully studying the diagrams.

Second, at first I thought the shoulder and stabilizer straps were poorly designed. I was wrong. They are designed for perfect ergonomics and balance. Again, this is a learning curve issue. In some ways Booq has been too clever in the design because there is a complexity that takes time to learn. For me it's worth it because I can carry a relatively heavy load (about thirty pounds) in a balanced fashion and still be assured that the tablet and a few other electronic odds and ends I carry are well protected. Protection is one area where Booq excels.

This is not trendy fine leather. Vegans will love it, and while I do not know exactly what it is, it's some sort of durable plastic material that is superbly constructed. The stitching, webbing, clasps and zippers are all first rate. Water literally rolls off it, and the reflective piping is a nice touch with respect to safety, whether walking or cycling.

Organizational options and features are another Booq hallmark. Instead of my trying to describe them in detail, look at the product photos on this page. There is a place for everything, and it has been well thought out. I've had this bag for a week and am still discovering compartments.

Bottom line: this is a bag that does take time to learn. It probably should come with a video or a link to one, which will make it immediately useful because I can assure you that the first day of ownership will be frustrating. Take your time and learn it because after that you will love it totally.

title: When I need them, I NEED them
text:
The older I get the more my clothes mysteriously shrink. I rarely wear dress clothes, preferring to flaunt the freedom retirement gives, but there are times when I do need to throw on a tie and look presentable.

That is where this gizmo comes in - I have beautiful shirts and ties still hanging in my closet, but the collars are, er, too tight. These allow me to fasten the top button and hide the small gap that remains with my tie. Also, it is nearly impossible to knot a tie and have it fall properly if you opt for leaving the collar unfastened. I tried that and it looks too sloppy.

Normally I would not need ten of these things, but in addition to my clothes shrinking in my old age I also find that I tend to lose things. I have these extenders stashed in drawers and on top of my dresser so one is always nearby on the off chance that I need it. Oh, I've also discovered that when I can easily find what I am looking for, my cussing dramatically decreases. Go figure!

title: Nice hats for five bucks
text:
At 4.99 for the pair and $4.99 for shipping and handling, the hats average out to under five bucks each.

I bought several inexpensive beanie hats from different vendors through Amazon and the four that I've received so far from the Florida Hat Company and Hair Coverings are all very good. They have a nice tight weave, so they are not slouchy beanies; they're beanies that look presentable. They are all nice, bright colors. Without any stretching, they each have a circumference of approximately 14 inches, which you can of course stretch to fit a normal size head.

I'm a small female who lives in New York and similar type hats have been my hat of choice for years. Each of the hats that I describe below have a good weave that is adequate enough to keep me warm in temperatures below fifty degrees; I don't find them suffocating hot in moderate temperatures and they keep me comfortable in thirty degree weather. I'm not foolish enough to stay out too long in temperatures lower than that; my lower earlobes may get a bit cold, but it's not bad.

From Hair Coverings, I bought two hats that were labeled royal blue, but in truth one is closer to teal in color and is more inexpensive. The royal blue is the best of the four hats in terms of the quality of the acrylic yarn and the weave. It has no pills. The length is 12 ¾ inches. The teal hat is also good, but the quality of the yarn isn't as flawless as the royal blue; it's a little pilly, since the thread looks a bit uneven. It's still a good hat, however. Its length is 11 ½ inches.

From the Florida Hat Co., I received the described hunter's orange hats that come as a pair. These have a slightly looser weave, but it's so minor that it's barely noticeable. The yarn is good, no pills. Its length is 11 ½ inches.

If anyone reading this is from the Highridge area of Yonkers and is familiar with the 99 cent store near Pathmark that sold similar beanies, you'll have a better reference as to the quality of these hats. Each of the hats I bought on-line are within the four to five dollar range; I purposely chose those low prices because I was looking for a hat that's similar to the hats I used to purchase in Yonkers, which had a nice weave, weren't too hot, and have held up well in the wash for years. Well, the on-line hats meet all those qualities and are a bit larger with a slightly tighter weave. For me, they're excellent, and I'm glad that I was able to find pretty, bright colors that offer some degree of visibility when I'm crossing the street.

title: Noisy material. Otherwise a solid vented SPF hat.
text:
PROS:

I have a 22" head. It is ALMOST too tight. But works.
The top of the hat is deep. So I can pull it down much further than in the photos. Fully over my eyebrows if I wanted.But it is tight enough that if I perch it higher it doesn't slip. (the bow in the back allows for further tightening).
CONS:
However the material feels more like nylon than polyester and thus makes a TON of noise every time you move your head and the back rubs against your shoulders. And the way it is shaped it cups your ears, funneling that "fwip fwip" noise right in at full volume.
If you use the ponytail hole it increases the noisy because it weighs down the back.
It also fights with the bow. You want the bow over the ponytail I think, but either way, the bow has to get distorted over or under the ponytail.

title: Save your money
text:
This pill box is extremely difficult to open once it's closed. And I am not some arthritic senior citizen, but an active 35 year old with good dexterity.

The lid fits too tightly once it's snapped shut, and the lip of the lid is flush with the bottom piece. Very aerodynamic I'm sure, but you'll break all your fingernails trying to pry it open. I have to use a nail file tip to open it again.

Also, the craftmanship of the piece is poor in general, especially for an item of this price. The sticker inside says "Made in Thailand", and frankly it shows.

Save your money and look for something else.

text: Fits well and very comfortable. Love the shade blue and heel height.

title: Great fit but hot!

I really wish I could love this and the other pattern dresses I bought. They fit perfect and ideal for what I needed them for- but oh the material they are made of keeps you very hot and uncomfortable. If you live in a hot area, even with it being sleeveless- it will be hot and uncomfortable .
Disappointed!
