title: Heavier than expected, flattering style
text: It's 51 degrees here today with winds 15 to 20mph and that is just way too cold for my tastes. This is heavy sweater weather for me and I'm pleased that this sweater is heavier than it looked in the photos. It is also well made and looks great on. The wrap style neckline is flattering and not too deep so it is perfectly suitable for the office. The material is soft and cozy with zero itch factor.

title: Comfy late at night with company
text: I like these pajamas for when we have over night guests and everyone wants to sit outside in the late evening and chat. These are cute and very soft, so they are easy to wear. The look is casual and definitely bedtime, but not sexy or revealing at all. These would certainly be appropriate for a hotel or even cruise ship environment.

title: Cute and comfortable
text: I like these sandals a lot. The heel isn't an ugly, chunky mess, but also isn't wobbly like a stilletto. These can be worn with jeans or a cute summer dress. After a full day at the office, my feet didn't hurt. There's a bit of cushion on the foot bed and the fit is true to size.

title: Runs a smidge small, very pretty
text:
I almost love this cute sweater, but it's a little small. Not a full size too small, but enough that it fits tighter than I normally care for.

The pink is a pretty, soft color that is not Barbie bright. The design on the shoulders is attractive and adds a dressier look overall. I like this sweater an awful lot, but wish it was correctly sized.

title: Cute dinosaur pants
text:
My husband thinks these are ridiculous....I think they are funny and as riding pants, extra silly.

The pants actually fit properly when using the size chart. The waistband stays put even when mounting and dismounting horses or shoveling stalls. The legs don't bunch or ride up or twist around when worn with tall boots.

title: Flattering and comfortable
text:
I don't wear a lot of dresses and I'm picky about the fit. This one is far better than I expected it to be. It's quite a flattering cut overall. The sweetheart neckline is pretty without being overexposed on cleavage.

Wearing this dress is east and comfortable. It's not fussy, but still moves well. I wore this to a fundraiser dinner with gorgeous 4 inch heels - I got lots of compliments. The deep navy blue is classic and timeless.

title: Well faceted for extra sparkle
text:
As a rule, I eschew any kind of fake gemstone. It feels just as cheap and disingenuous to wear fake diamonds etc as it does to carry a knock off handbag.

However, there are certainly times and places when I do not want to wear my very expensive vintage emerald engagement and wedding rings. Riding horses in the desert, day tripping in Mexico, swimming at a public pool, or working on fences on the ranch. I don't want to go around without my wedding rings either, so an inexpensive fake option is required.

This particular ring is actually quite tasteful and well constructed. The stone has 6 prongs to hold it safely in place and the silver plate has a high shine. I love that it's size adjustable without looking adjustable. The stone itself is very sparkly and clean looking. It reflects light surprisingly well and that's because it's actually faceted well. I'm pairing this ring with a simple gold eternity band with tiny diamond chips and I got two compliments at the gas station yesterday. So far, this meets my needs as a substitute for my good jewelry when required.

title: Soft, cute casual t-shirt
text: I'm a sucker for soft, comfy t-shirts that require no special care. This one is great for grooming horses or playing with the dogs. It's cool and dries fast if it gets wet. It's a relaxed fit, so no binding or feeling tight at the throat.

title: Ok, but a little hot
text: I have a couple of similar pants from different brands that I wear when exercising horses. These are ok, but they feel hotter than my others. Definitely not summer pants for me

title: Badly constructed
text: Alas, this pretty bra with lots of lift and support has a fatal flaw. The ring on one shoulder strap has a sharp metallic edge due to poor quality control in manufacturing. It ground into my skin as soon as I put the bra on. No thanks.

title: Fit is correct
text:
For no name jeans, these are definitely better than expected. The denim is a smidge thinner than my regular jeans, but it's not flimsy or weak.

They fit as expected and don't stretch too far away from the original fit by the end of the day. I was comfortable wearing these while working outside on a barn project and they survived the washer and dryer without shrinking.

title: Too short for my tastes
text:
Technically, these shorts are the size advertised. They fit, but are so trashy short, I would never leave the house wearing them. If I bend over, an inappropriate view results.... definitely not something you want while grocery shopping.

The fabric, what little of it there is, is stretchy and easy to wear. The pockets are shallow and essentially useless for carrying a phone. These will end up being laundry day shorts and nothing else.

title: True to size, warm and comfortable
text:
My husband has Sasquatch size feet and finding him footwear that fits properly and looks good can be tricky. These boots turned out to be a great pick.

The size 13 actually is a size 13 and fits him perfectly. He said once he added his inserts, the boots were extremely comfortable. He's been wearing them daily for a week now is very happy. I think they look good on him.

title: Warm in the desert mountains
text:
I wore these hiking in the Bofecillos Mountains in deep West Texas the other day. It was 32 degrees when we started our trek and in the 50s when we finished. The pants were warm and more comfortable than I expected actually.

My only complaint is they are a little too long for me. It's not a deal breaker as long as I wear tall hiking boots that I can tuck these into.

title: Not thermal at all
text:
You can't have enough decent socks if you hike or ride horses. I do both year round. These are mid weight, not thin or thick. They certainly are not thermal winter socks as the description claims - not by a stretch.

I've worn these three times now - twice out hiking in the desert mountains of Big Bend National Park and once just working around the ranch and the house. The socks stay in place without twisting around - even when climbing. They don't shift or rub and are pretty comfortable.

title: No pockets
text: First....this is NOT a sweatshirt. It's just a long sleeve tshirt with a hood. Also,  no pockets which ruins the functionality of a hoodie for me. However, as just a long sleeve tshirt,  this is fine. It wears well and doesn't look too sloppy. I do like the colors as well.

title: Very obviously fake
text:
I rarely wear any fake jewelry, but I thought this might be pretty and if it gets lost or broken when I'm riding horses it won't matter.

Unfortunately, the necklace just screams FAKE as soon as the box is opened. It's visually too bright, too reflective and way too yellow. My husband walked by and asked if I was shopping in the kid's Halloween section now.

title: Fits properly and is comfortable with good support
text: This is what a tshirt bra is supposed to be. It has a smooth, soft appearance under clothing and is fully lined. The straps are lightly padded and that definitely makes it more comfortable to wear for a long day. I'm pleased to see the cups are sized correctly and don't gape. I've worn this bra three times now while working on a travel trailer remodel and it has been completely comfortable. It doesn't ride up or pinch and the back hooks are covered so they aren't pressing into my skin. There is plenty of support as well for those of us on the larger end of things.

title: Soft, so soft
text: Is there anything better than soft, fleecy pjs on a cold, rainy morning? This is nice set especially if you have company and don't want to get dressed without looking like a slob. These are very soft and easy to wear. I like them for curling up with a good book and a better dog.

title: Nothing special or unusual,  just decent socks
text: I don't love these socks, but there's no real reason not to. They fit ok. They are pretty soft and comfortable to wear. I personally, think the pattern and colors are just ugly.  There's some cushioning and these stay put all day. I don't see anything special here though....just regular socks.

title: Super soft and easy to wear
text: I kind of love this pullover. It's very soft even after going through the washer and dryer a couple of times. The fit is a tad oversized, but not huge. It's just comfortable and easy to move in - there's no binding under the arms or around the bust area. The material is thick and very warm in a chill breeze outside. I find myself reaching for this way more often than expected.

title: Very thin material,  loose threads after washing
text: I expected a waffle weave style sweatshirt. Because that is what the description says. Instead,  I have a waffle weave long sleeve tshirt. It is very thin material that would be see through in a lighter color. Totally useless in cold weather. I wanted to layer this under another heavy, actual sweatshirt for barn chores. It's just too thin and oversized for that. Meanwhile,  after washing and drying this twice, there are already threads coming loose. Just poor quality.

title: Right thickness for loafers
text: Sometimes you need socks that are a little thinner to wear with loafers. These aren't sneaker or boot socks for sure, but they are fine for flats. The material is a tad scratchy,  but better after a trip through the laundry with fabric softener.

title: These make a good back up pair
text: These are large sunglasses which is good down in West Texas. They block the sun on the sides as well as directly in front. They are polarized as far as I can tell. They look good on. These aren't high end sunglasses and feel a little flimsy compared to name brands we already have. But as a spare pair to keep in the truck, these are fine.

title: Added reader lens is genius
text:
This is summer in Texas. That means sunglasses are an absolute must every time you step outside. I have to have prescription lenses only, so these are for my husband. These are not as dark as he usually wears, so when he's working with the horses or is out at the ranch, he prefers his old sunglasses.

He really likes the added reader lens included as a bifocal on these though and they are great when he's driving. He gets the sun glare protection and can still see a map without removing them. I think they look good on him - a bit modern and fresher than the old Ray-Ban style he's worn for decades.

title: Soft and stay up without sliding
text:
I do some hiking in the West Texas mountains every year and socks are a vital part of that. Good socks are the difference between blisters and not. I've worn these twice with my hiking boots just doing normal stuff and the socks are really comfortable. They fit properly and don't slide around when you're climbing a small muddy hill or over rocks.

These are soft and feel good on the skin. The tops stay up, but they don't bind or leave marks on my legs. I've run these through the laundry twice and they haven't lost shape or elasticity. I'll definitely pack these on my next trip out to Big Bend in October.

title: Medium quality leather and construction. Small
text: This is a little duffle bag, not as large as the photos make it appear. It's not large enough for a weekend trip by any stretch. It's best suited as a gym bag perhaps or to carry electronic stuff with your clothing in a different bag. The leather is ok, not high quality, but not thin garbage either. This won't be my go to bag or replace my good leather luggage, but it's fine as a back up in a pinch.

title: Itchy, thin polyester
text: I love a blazer year round, but this one is not for me. It's made out of polyester and not the good kind. The fabric is itchy and has a weird swishing noise when you touch it. The fit is pretty unflattering if you have broad shoulders and a narrow waist - very boxy. I can't see myself ever wearing this

title: Nice for shade on a hot day
text: My husband loves a classic fedora style hat and wears several. He likes this one for riding horses with me. It stays on and the brim is wide enough to give him some face shade.

title: Loose weave is pulling apart and the hat is tiny.
text: I'm just not impressed here. The material is very soft and the neutral tan and white pretty much go with everything. However, the quality is sketchy. It's a very loose weave that is already pilling and coming loose on the scarf after just two uses. The hat is really small and essentially useless for my needs. This isn't terrible, it's just not high quality or durable.

title: Comfortable, looks great on. The grey is really nice
text: This grey is very soft and classic in tone and it goes well with pretty much everything. The sweater is soft and has a little bit of give in the material. Ribbing can be awkward if done badly, but they got it right on this sweater - not too wide. I think it looks great on and I received three compliments within 30 minutes at a ladies club lunch the other day.

title: Too big for my husband and not adjustable. Cute and warm though
text: I intended for this to be a fun cap for my husband. However, it's too big for him and you can't adjust the fit at all. It's soft and warm, but just sliding down over his eyes constantly. However, I found a saving grace. It's a cute hat for our Plott Hound, Traveler. He loves a hat, any hat will do, but this one is cutest.

title: Very soft, comfy adjustable fit and a bright white that's easy to see
text: I don't wear hats except for my riding helmet, but my Plott Hound wears hats. It's sort of a ritual now with him after I put the first one on him during a cold wind on a walk. This one is very soft - love acrylic. I love that it's bright white because I can easily spot my dog and his hat on a woodland trail. He loves this hat because it covers his ears and stays in place and will be warm this winter. Seriously, this is a good dog hat.

title: Deep red color is pretty, comfortable on with large, floppy brim
text:
I'm a believer in sun hats when I travel and at home - sun damage is irreversible and Texas summer sun isn't to be trifled with. This one is along the lines of old school, floppy, giant sun hat styling. It has a wide, loose bring that flops a bit and can be tilted down or up, away from the eyes. The head part is deep and could fit over a loose, small bun if you're careful.

There's no chin strap, so this hat isn't suitable for the beach or boating at all - it'll blow away in a breeze. Think of it as sunny, still day poolside, window shopping or long walk sort of hat. There's ok ventilation and I haven't noticed excessive heat wearing it outside to do light yard work or walk dogs. This is not a hat you want to roll up and throw in a suitcase for a long trip, it won't survive much of that type of abuse. I really like the vivid red color - it looks fun and cheerful.

title: Nice bra with good lift and shaping
text: Sometimes you just want a pretty bra, but you still need support and actual coverage at the same time. This bra meets all three of those requirements for me and it's pretty comfortable as well. The fit is good and the straps stay in place like the should without sliding off my shoulders. The cups are correctly sized and lined so nothing shows through at inappropriate moments. The lace sling definitely gives extra support and shaping which can look lovely under a thick, slouchy sweater - sort of helps give you a sleeker profile even in a sloppy outfit.

title: Arrived cosmetically damaged. Thin leather, unfinished inside with chemical odor
text:
Well, this is a disappointment in a couple of ways. I'm an avid collector of high end, high quality, well made leather goods and I have several pieces that have been in service for 10 and 15 years that still look beautiful and show almost no wear. (I have a Floto bag that is 17 years old and is in weekly rotation and an Yves Saint Laurent bag that's 16 years old and simply gorgeous with seriously hard use) The key is construction from only very high quality leather that is finely finished without skimping. Unfortunately, this piece does not meet those two minimum requirements from minute one.

It arrived with scratches and scrapes on both the front and back. The interior is not finished or sealed - it's just left raw and rough. The entire piece has an odor - fine leather should smell delicious in that way that only fine leather can. This smells....off. The leather is thin and bends creating crease marks each time. My problem here is that this isn't high quality and it's advertised as such.

This is a very tiny little, unfinished pouch that will hold a few business cards or some coins in a pinch. It's not fancy. It's not made from high end material and it's not something I would ever give as a gift or carry myself.

title: Excellent ring, looks great, indestructible
text: My husband is an armorer and loves the Tungsten material for his wedding ring - doesn't scratch or get damaged in daily work with tools and the like and always looks great with minimal cleaning. However... the man is ridiculous with regard to losing rings. He's on his third one in seven years! First one was stolen by the cat as we both watched after he took it off to scrub grease off his hands at the kitchen sink. (Last we saw was it being swatted down the disposal by said feline) Second one was lost in an 80 acre pasture during an argument with a hysterical horse trying to dislodge my husband and buck him off all the way home. (one day someone will find that ring, but it won't be us) Now... knowing his history, I have gone ahead and pre-purchased this one as my secret "wife knows you and is prepared for your foolishness" back up ring. Men...gotta love them.

title: Order at least 2 sizes larger than you usually wear and wash on gentle cycle in cool water.
text: I typically wear S-M, but because this top is 100% cotton, and imported, I  ordered XL. The fit is perfect, the color a beautiful pale blue and works great with a cami underneath. Very satisfied with product. Actually ordered a second one in another color.

text: It's okay, but smaller than I expected.

title: Great idea and works nice but....
text: I really was happy with it until the magnet came out... I found another one and gorilla glued it, so it works great now....

title: These work okay, but are ugly
text:
These sunglasses fit okay, but were not really comfortable for me. The problem is in the earpieces. They did not fit well, and slid if I looked down. I have to say I did not care for the esthetics of this pair either... they were ugly!

I cannot recommend this pair of sunglasses, and would definitely not buy them again.

title: Stretchy, but runs a little tight. Stripes are very tight
text:
It is so hard to buy new brands of plus size tops online. It's a roll of the dice.

This top is much softer than I expected. It looks like a french terry, which I find rough, but it is soft and stretchy.

It runs a little small. I liked the color and the hood. What I did NOT like was the twill bands around the upper arms. Again, manufacturers don't think: if I need this size, the odds are good that I have fat arms too. They were too tight for comfort. So, I am going to take a seam ripper and remove the twill. The rest of the top is okay.

I haven't washed it yet, so I can't really say if it shrinks or fades. But for now, I love the hoodie and overall comfort.

title: Nope.  Shows every bump or roll. Not complimentary at all
text:
I'm sorry to say this, but as a plus-sized woman, just pass on this one.

It is reasonably close to size. The only nice thing I can say is that it has pockets in the top, super nice to tuck in a tissue.

The basic design is nice, but because of the fabric used, it just clings in a VERY uncomplimentary way. Every bump, lump and roll is highlighted, and the top pulls over it. It is just ugly.

So, still on the hunt for a top that won't highlight chubby parts and is still comfortable to wear.

title: Hard to beat the price
text:
Well, hard to beat the price!
These are plastic framed magnifying glasses. I have to have them now to work on crafts, or read stuff - you know, when you've reached the age where body parts just don't work like they used to!

These came packaged very well. Each pair has its own black fabric case.
The frames are an assortment of colors. The lens area is pretty large. I probably wouldn't wear these out in public, but at home, family is used to me, so they don't mind. 😁

On one pair, the lenses look like they have concentric circles on them, and it is a little annoying. The screws have already worked loose on a couple other pairs, but hey - I have three other pairs I can wear while I put the screws back in!

Overall, not a stylish set, but I didn't buy them for style. I wanted inexpensive magnifiers so I could have a pair in every room. That's what I got!

title: Nice quality
text:
We purchased one of these a few years ago.
It finally cracked beyond use, but lasted a long time with daily wear.
Very nice quality for casual use.
Came back and bought another color.

title: Cute 3D TARDIS earrings
text:
These were not purchased for myself but for my daughter.
The earrings are ADORABLE, and a very nice quality. They have a 3D shape, as opposed to being a flat metal charm-style earring.
She liked them so much, she has already purchased another pair before they stop carrying them.

Two thumbs up on this design - very cute!

Great product
Order a few sizes up

title: Amazing customer service even though I made the error
text: I complained to Shrine saying these were awful! Turned out, I ordered the wrong ones! My first order were the boxer-briefs that are amazing. Best underwear I have ever worn. Waist band does not roll even with my ample belly and material does not bunch, amazing underwear. So Shrine explained my error and then offered to send me the correct ones that I loved. Wow what customer service. They have a customer for life even though it was my error! Thank you

title: Ruby Necklace
text: I will be very happy to see if my daughter likes the necklace for Christmas. It's really a lovely piece

title: A waste of money
text: I wore these one day and they started coming apart at the seams in the crotch area.  A total waste of money.

title: Nice quality, and it FITS ...
text:
I recently went through some health issues that landed me in the hospital for 2 weeks and in a skilled nursing facility for 6 weeks. I got tired of wearing hospital gowns, so I ordered a couple of these in different colors, and they worked fine. The fit is great -- I usually wear a size 2X in Worman Within, or 3X in anything from QVC -- I ordered a 4X in this nightshirt and it was perfect -- a little loose but that's how i like it.

Colors are nice. The only drawback is it can't be dried in the dryer. At this point, I wash by hand and dry on a hanger in the bathroom. It works fine. Love the colors and style.

title: Better than I expected ...
text:
These are heavy felt slip-in cases for small- to mid-size reading glasses. After cataract surgery, I find I need multiple different strengths in reading glasses depending on what I'm doing (1.75 for computer work, 2.25-2.50 for reading, 3.0 for needlework, etc.), so I tend to purchase lower-cost readers here on Amazon and find cases to fit. I like to use different colors to designate the different strengths (gray for computer work, blue for reading, purple for crafts, etc.). These work great for that purpose. They're heavy enough to provide some protection for my glasses, and I like the combination of colors.

Very happy with these -- definitely better than I expected given the cost.

title: Beautiful colors ...
text:
Where do I begin? This is so much prettier in person than in the pictures. I tend to wear a lot of solid jewel-tone tops and use scarves to "fancy them up" a bit. This one goes with at least 4 of my tops (jade green, red, hot pink, and black). It's silky feeling (100% polyester satin), very soft and easy to drape and knot in a number of different ways.

I really love it! It's accompanying me on my current trip (a 131-day world cruise). Solid 5 stars!

title: So close!  Need a little adjustment ...
text:
After having cataract surgery in both eyes a few years ago, I find that I need readers in a variety of strengths for different activities: computer work, reading printed books, needlework, etc. So I tend to purchase a lot of readers and I'm always on the lookout for styles/designs that will work in a variety of settings including outdoors. So readers combined with sunglasses are a definite plus for me. Even more attractive are bifocal readers that allow me to look up from reading and still focus on the scenery around me (I do a lot of cruise travel in balcony cabins ... )

These are nearly perfect as bifocal sunglass readers go. I love the shape, the frame, the fit, the case -- everything. There's one flaw, however: the bifocal "line" -- that actual cut in the lens below which the bifocal "reading" lens is placed -- is just a little too low for these to work comfortably "as is." In order to see clearly through the reader lens portion, I have to tilt my head back -- and this is after pushing the nose piece as high as I can. I can manage that tilt for awhile, but eventually my neck gets tired.

This would be so easy to fix -- just raise that bifocal line 1-2 millimeters, and the placement would be perfect. I can get them to work by attaching adhesive nose piece pads that will raise the level enough so that I can read comfortably, but I really shouldn't have to do that.

As is, as much as I'd love to love these, I can only say "they're OK."

title: Nice fit and beautiful quality ...
text:
I recently returned from a 4-week cruise to Hawaii, Tahiti, and the Marquesas. I explored Honolulu and Hilo for a souvenir shirt and didn't find anything of the quality and price I wanted (seriously, WAY overpriced at the shops). I waited until I returned home and explored my options on Amazon. Saw this shirt and decided to give it a try.

Very happy I did -- the quality of the material and construction is much better than one would expect for this price point. Even the pocket has been carefully cut and aligned so that it blends seamlessly into the fabric pattern (see photo).

I'm a plus-size woman who usually wears a size 2X from Woman Within or 3X from Travelsmith or NorthStyle. I ordered size 4X in this shirt and it fits as expected -- a little large, but I prefer a looser fit. I could probably have done just fine in a 3X without feeling like it was too small.

Overall, very happy with my purchase. Washes nicely, comfortable to wear, fit and fabric/construction quality better than expected. Solid 5 stars.

title: Comfy, warm and they FIT!
text:
Wearing size 11W women's shoes, I often have trouble finding things to fit, especially more casual footwear like slippers. This is my first pair of Dearfoams, and I'm happy to say that the XL size fits my large-ish feet beautifully! I purchased them to take along on my trek to visit family for the holidays for two weeks where "casual" at-home wear was key.

I'm happy to report that these performed beautifully. No tight spots anywhere, but they're not overly large, either. They stay on going up and down stairs, too -- that, to me, is the real test of "fit." They got a good workout, with daily wear (evening and morning for a couple of hours each) and stuffing into my suitcase. I'm planning to take them along on my next adventure: a cruise to Hawaii, Tahiti, and the Marquesas.

Very happy with these. Would purchase again (and I may look for other styles from this manufacturer since I now know the fit will work ... )

title: Versatile, great size, good quality -- exceeded expectations ...
text:
Really lovely, nice size, well made. I purchased this to take along on a cruise to Alaska, hoping it could serve "double duty" as a shawl for the "fancier" dinner events as well as a warmer scarf to wear on-deck while viewing glaciers. I'm happy to report it worked beautifully! It was just the right size to work as a lightweight shawl for dinner and then doubled as a warm scarf.

It's definitely higher quality than I expected -- the amount of "sparkle" is perfect! Not too flashy, more understated elegance, but definitely "there."

Would absolutely recommend without reservation -- I love it!

title: Great for wider faces, work very nicely for folks who spend hours in front of a computer screen ...
text:
UPDATE Jan 23, 2017: They fell apart today. The nose piece completely disintegrated where it attaches to one of the lenses. Even though I have all the "pieces," there's no way to repair since the plastic in the lens where the nose piece attaches crumbled. So I got 5 months of use -- not rough use; just normal use for working on the computer (put 'em on in the morning; take 'em off at night before I go to bed). I was hoping for at least a year before I'd need to replace. As I said, I know these are not the same quality as $200 readers, but even so, I would expect more than 5 months of use.

ORIGINAL REVIEW: After having cataract surgery a few years ago, I've been struggling to find the "right" glasses for all of the various activities I enjoy: working on the computer, reading, needlework, etc. For those who haven't had the pleasure of cataract surgery, it usually leaves you with incredible distance vision (20/20 in most cases) but close-up vision is gone because the eyes can no longer change focus. The ophthalmologist told me I'd probably need several different strengths, a different one for each activity, so I've been experimenting with various options to try to find the "right" combination.

These Eyekepper Computer Reading Glasses are the PERFECT solution for my computer work as well as for in the car so I can see the dials/gauges on the dashboard. This is the 4th different pair I've tried, and I think this will be the last. They fit, they definitely cut down glare, and the strength (I got 1.75) is accurate.

First, understand that these are NOT $200 reading glasses. They will likely not hold up like $200 glasses. They're very lightweight, and the ear pieces are very slender and feel ... well ... delicate, I guess is the word. I don't think they will hold up to any sort of rough handling. But if you're prepared to be careful with these, they should work fine. And the company does offer a lifetime breakage warranty, so that provides some reassurance that the manufacturer stands behind the product.

The color is a very pale peachy gold, and the lenses have a slight peach tint to help reduce. At an angle, you can see the slight blue over-tint that contributes to eye comfort when you spend hours staring at a computer screen. The rimless style works well, too, as I often have to look "over" the glasses to see distance, and these are the perfect size and fit for that.

A final word about fit: I have a rather broad/wide face and I've had problems in the past with readers that are too narrow, resulting in pinching and pressure points Not so with these. They're wide enough that they actually fit my wider face, and they're so lightweight that there's NO pressure on my ears or nose. I really like that aspect.

So overall, these work brilliantly. I couldn't be happier. I'll probably order another pair just to have a spare. Solid enthusiastic 5 stars.

title: Works for wide faces ...
text:
I like to "live" with a pair of reading glasses for a few days to see how they fit and feel, as well as making sure the strength works like it should. I had cataract surgery a few years ago, and I'm finding I need different strengths in reading glasses for different activities: working on the computer, reading, driving (reading the dials and gauges), and needlework (thread/lace crochet).

I purchased these in the stronger strength (3.0) for my needlework, and so far, they're working fine.

I have a rather wide face, and many of the less expensive readers are just too narrow. These fit great -- they're wide enough that there are no pinching or pressure points, and they stay in place on my nose. The strength matches a more expensive pair of 3.0x readers, so I'm confident in the accuracy of these.

My only quibble is that they're a bit on the heavy side compared to plastic-frame readers. It's not uncomfortable, but it is noticeable. This is, I'm sure, due to the metal frames plus the thickness of the lenses. It's not a deal-breaker for me, but I thought it deserved mentioning.

Overall, I'm really pleased with these. I've been using them daily for about 10 days and I've noticed no deterioration at all -- nothing is loose or feeling "flimsy."

I may order another pair in a lower strength to use for reading.

title: Handy headwear for chilly days, but snug and definitely not for windy days or extreme cold.
text:
I've only had this a few days but used it quite a bit (we're having a cold snap!) and it's handy and versatile. I like that the neck part is long, so you can either bunch it up like in the picture or tuck the bottom under the collar of your coat and zip your coat up to keep your neck extra cozy. I was hoping the neck piece could be slipped over my nose easily, but with the hood up if just doesn't work well. You CAN, but if the hood is up it makes it bulge out or fall off unless you scrunch up the draw chords (which I think makes your face look like it's poking out out a sphincter). I like that I can flip the hood back and just use the neck part, then just slip the hood back on if my ears get cold - saves me having to stop what I'm doing and look for a hat.
It's of medium quality construction (fine for the price) and very useful for the right weather conditions. It's warm unless there's wind, which seems to cut through it pretty easy and chill my ears. But that also lets the air move so my head doesn't sweat or get over-hot, which is nice. Definitely not the thing for super cold (below 20F) weather or if there's a chilly wind. The faux fur is pretty soft and feels nice, and lines the entire hood and neck (not just around the face like many hoods) which I like.... even though it's not enough to keep the wind out, it does feel nice to wear. It's snug on me and I have a small head for an adult. It'd be cuter if the hood were a little looser. Would be cozy on a kid - definitely not for anyone with a big head.

Overall a fine buy for the money, but it's something I'll use while working outside on cold but not very windy days - I'll definitely choose something else for around town.

You could feel the absorbent material almost like grains of sand, but it was all at one end and seemed like a very small amount. Seemed like about half a teaspoon or less material in there. Didn't seem like it could possibly be enought. On the ones I used previously, this center section was more like a quilted material between the two outer layers with no loose absorbent material floating around inside.

Well, to my amazement, once I soaked them for a few minutes, the absorbent material expanded beyond my imagination, growing enough to fill and puff out the tube section much like a sausage. You have to sort of smoosh it around a bit to distribute it evenly, but it very nicely fills the tube section and expands considerably. Once full of water, the absorbent material seems to have the consistancy of a thick pudding, so it is fairly easy to distribute evenly. It does hold water very well and it will take a couple days to dry back out to that miniscule amount of granules in a couple clumps. I believe these actually hold more water than the ones I used previously.

They will keep you cool and if you chill them in the fridge once wet, the quick cool is refreshing. You can use them as a headband or just drape over the back of your neck. After you've been wearing it for awhile, they do seem to develop just a slight bit of sliminess on the surface. I am not sure it that is from the absorbent material or from sweat. If you rinse and re-wet them with cold water, that seems to go away.

All that said, they do seem to work to help keep you cool. These are different than the ones I used before mainly by the pecular way they pick up water and fill the tube.

I am pretty sure that the absorbent material is the same stuff they put in disposable diapers, I think the other ones I used before actually had a piece of the cloth like diaper material with the absorbent material blended into it, while these just seem to have the absorbent only.

They do work, are re-usable and they look pretty good. They are about 36" long from end to end, enough to tied behind your head as a headband, but it seems like a just a few inches longer might be better, At a couple bucks apiece, they are cheap enough. I'm giving them 4 stars mainly because they were a bit different than I expected, but they seem to work as well.

title: long, smooth, lightweight with tight weave, generous sizing
text:
Lightweight, generously sized hoodie with plenty of length for my tall 5'10.5" frame. The material has a tight weave, so while it is lightweight the tight weave will help keep out cold and even some rain. Totally fine for lounging around the house, or for wearing under a long coat, or even as a "coat" for those that dont like wearing real coats. Roomy enough to go over other layers. The side elastic pull strings help give it a more fitted look. The zipper goes in both directions for added flexibility in movement. I find the cut and style already helps me with that.

Has pockets (yay!) which arrive lightly sewn. This is not all that unusual. Helps to keep the material to lay flat. Sometimes that occurs with pants too. Just a light snip of thread should help it unravel enough to pull through.

I bought the 2xl, which according to their list is slightly conflicting. It says it fits size 20-22, but then it says fits bust 44.5-46. Size 20/22 is usually more bust size closer to 50, and I think this IS more of a size 20/22. Anyway, I went with the 2XL (size 18/20, size 48 ish bust), and could easily gone down one size. It doesnt look frumpy since the elastic cords allow me to make it more snug. Just just know that this has a forgiving size.

It really met my expectations. It looks like it does in the pictures, and for that I am giving it full 5 star rating. If I experience anything else, I'll be back to update

title: just what my eyes needed. Fits wide head, comfy, attractive, reduces glare, comes w/ extra goodies
text:
Had a pair similar to these, might have even been this brand I dont know. When after a few seasons I snapped them on a hike, I knew I needed another pair. I remember they were inexpensive (sub $10), and that the lens were very good at reducing glare but not reducing sight. I also have a thing for the shape of the lens. Some are oddly curved and my eyes get weirded out which makes me feel dizzy. So when I saw these, saw that they appeared to look very similar to my others, and was within the price range I remembered buying for, I figured it was worth the try. So I bought them.

PHEW! They are nearly identical to what I had. Fits my large, wide head comfortably, does not aggravate my eyes, reduces glare, yet doesn't reduce what I see. The dark green lens on these cover my eyes, but are a nice change up from a totally black lens. Comes with a carrying bag, lens wipe cloth, a polarized test card, and a mini screw driver to tighten. ALL in a nice box. Those last few details really upped the experience- I didnt expect the extras. I just wanted my eyes to feel good, look good.. and I got all that and more (without breaking the bank!).

Perfectly fine glass. Not fancy looking, but just what I wanted.

title: large, lightweight open tote, clear designs & color, inner side pocket, multi purpose
text:
It's a tote, and exactly as described and pictured. I am rating it based on what I expected from product description, and it fulfils that completely. Lightweight, open tote with handles, one interior pocket. It is within price range for size and quality. Very typical, yet has added benefit of rip stop waterproof material. Color and print are clear and bright (even though mine is black cats & other graphics on white background, the colors and design are sharp, not muddled).

Simply nice for any toting needs. I hoard totes, have a variety of styles and select based on my needs of the day. I have a small purse that gets tossed in a tote along with anything else I want to carry that day. My go to high quality ultra durable purse like tote has been this cute tote by [[ASIN:B07GQDT5CN Studio Oh!]]. But this Ycinas tote is tote-ally (totally) appropriate for beach, groceries, trip to the library, as a spare bag tucked into another bag, general catch all, etc. Unless it falls apart soon, I see no reason not to give it 5 stars for what it is.

title: light to mid weight long sleeved jersey knit t-shirt hoodie
text:
Lightweight- good for cool summer night/morning, or fall day with some layers. It is a heavy long sleeve t-shirt style hoodie, jersey knit. Has lots and lots of stretch. Sizing is accurate. Go with your size if you want a loose fit, or go smaller if you want more fitted.

Where the length lands depends on your body. I am 5'10" with a long torso, and the material doesn't fully cover my bum like it does in the product pics. Close though. Sleeves are actually long enough. I find that I can push them up, or roll them up if I need them to be shorter. Hood is generous, and has a pull string. The hood is not too heavy or cumbersome. Not choking/constricting feeling. Good sized kangaroo pocket doesnt add much bulk.

I'm 5'10" 270 lbs. I had dropped a few pounds, so my usual 2XL is loose. Even so, I went with 2xl because the bust measurement says 52", and I am 50". The next size down is 48" for XL. I figured with a hoodie, larger is better.. but now that i have it, given that it has so much stretch, the XL would have been fine.

I have this in green, and it is a lovely grayish green. I am tempted to buy another in another color. Currently priced at $20.79, I am thinking about it as I think that is reasonable for a lightweight long sleeved t-shirt.

Edit to add: I did buy another one size smaller, in black. I like the fit better.

title: wide rib band reduces overflow/rolls; good fit overall
text:
As someone who doesnt often wear a bra, this isn't too uncomfortable. I can tell its on, but I am not itching to take it off. It fits surprisingly well. I am plus sized but dont have the boobs to go with it, which can make it hard to find a bra. I need the side support in the form of wide rib bands, the wider shoulder bands are nice as the bra doesnt dig in. The cups are soft but foamy- definitely lends added structure and smoothness. The "push up" part is more in the overall cup and how it lays rather than there being a padded shelf to hoist them on--they should take that out from title description-- misleading. If you want that, you wont get that here. I failed to see the term push up in the description, so I am glad i doesnt do this. I just wanted a more structured and comfortable underwire bra for days I actually wear a bra (or wear something more than super basic soft cup with no structure).

5 stars because I will actually wear this. Have blown too much money on bras I immediately hated (and cant return because of nature of garment).

title: very short necklace: 15.5". Chain does not match pictures. Ugly gold box chain, ok pendant
text:
I am done with Zista jewelry. The description does not quite match what is received. The pendant is ok. Pretty-ish, but not as pretty and of quality looking that it should. I do have another Zista pendant and that is very pretty, but just like with this listing the chain is nowhere close to what it looks like in the picture. 1 star rating for both.

I normally expect a basic cheap chain. If everything looked as it should and lined up with what is shown and described in the product description- then I would highlight that and consider it in my rating. But it doesn't.Usually a pendant is purchased for that part alone, and the chain is a token add on. But with this, I chose it based on the look of the chain and the look of the pendant as per the description. I am not pleased with either.

The chain is a block "gold"- a weird color at that. One tone. The chain is very short. Barely 16". I cant even clasp it around my neck. If you have a super petite frame, then maybe it will work for you. Either way, this is a very short chain. The other one I have by Zista just barely closes, and is like a tight choker. SO this is even shorter. Sad.

The pendant is petite, and barely pretty. It doesn't look as pretty as it does in the picture. None of it is looking as it should. Disappointed.
